catalog.name: edit
catalog.description: Apply exact text replacements to a file. Each oldText must occur exactly once in the current file content - include surrounding lines when a short string would match more than once - and the edits are applied in the order given. Build large generated files incrementally: aim for at most 8 KiB of new content per call, preserve the rest of the file, and split larger additions across multiple calls.

catalog.name: find
catalog.description: List files whose path relative to the search root matches a glob pattern (** spans directories, * stays within one path segment, ? is one character). Build and dependency directories and paths policy denies are passed over, and the result says which.

catalog.name: grep
catalog.description: Search file contents under a directory with a regular expression, or with a literal string when literal is true. Returns path:line:text, with context lines marked path-line-text. Build and dependency directories, binary files and paths policy denies are passed over, and the result says which. The path may also be an artifact:// path from a truncated output note, to search that output; the line numbers match what read shows.

catalog.name: harness_propose
catalog.description: Propose a change to prompts, memory, skills or subagent specs. Proposals are queued and reviewed; there is no direct write path.

catalog.name: ls
catalog.description: List the entries of a directory. A directory is shown with a trailing slash, a symbolic link with @ and anything else with ?. Entries policy denies are not listed, and the result says how many were left out.

catalog.name: mcp_manage
catalog.description: Connect MCP servers to this Agnes Harness (AGH), visible in Settings → MCP. Use prepare with a definition, then commit its proposalId for native user confirmation. Default target is AGH, not another client. Dependencies/add-ons alone are not registration. End this turn after submission; tools become available on later turns. Use list/status to verify actual results. Credentials belong in AGH secure settings, never chat.

catalog.name: plugin_helper_create
catalog.description: Save newly authored AGH plugin files in a fresh workspace directory and inspect an exact content bundle. Read plugin_helper_guide first. Returns prepared with capabilities and integrity; does not install or execute candidate code. No imports of existing directories. Stop on policy rejection; do not bypass using shell.

catalog.name: plugin_helper_guide
catalog.description: Before creating an Agnes Harness (AGH) plugin, read this version-matched authoring guide and runnable template. The default target for “write a plugin” in this app is AGH. Skill content alone uses skill-helper; connecting an MCP server uses mcp-helper. This helper authors ordinary tool, Skill or pure CSS skin plugin rows.

catalog.name: plugin_helper_install
catalog.description: Request native confirmation to install, trust and enable the exact prepared AGH plugin, or query/cancel its proposal. Creating a plugin does not authorize installation. submitted means pending activation: end this turn, then status checks actual running state; new tools appear on later turns. Denial/cancellation must not be retried or bypassed automatically.

catalog.name: read
catalog.description: Read a text file. Returns lines prefixed with their 1-based line number. Use offset (first line) and limit (number of lines) to page through large files. Also takes the artifact:// path from a truncated output note, to read the rest of that output the same way.

catalog.name: run_code
catalog.description: Run a Python cell in the persistent kernel. Call harness tools via `await tools.<name>(...)`. Assign large results to variables and print summaries. `%%bash` on the first line runs a throw-away shell.

code.description: The program to run in this cell.

description.description: One line describing what this cell does.

catalog.name: shell
catalog.description: Run a foreground command line in the session shell. Output is captured; long output is stored as an artifact. timeoutMs can shorten the call within the session limit. Background jobs are unavailable in this runtime.

catalog.name: skill_helper_create
catalog.description: 仅用于用户要求创作的新内容；已有目录应使用 import，禁止导入失败后逐文件重建。保存当前模型依据 skill-creator 编写的 Skill 文件并准备受控安装。不覆盖已有 Skill，不代替模型生成内容，不执行脚本。name 是安装目录名，只能用英文字母、数字、点、下划线、连字符，如 weekly-report；中文名称写在 SKILL.md 的 name 字段。文件路径相对 Skill 根目录，必须包含 SKILL.md。

name.description: ASCII directory identifier, e.g. requirement-organizer. Put the Chinese display name in SKILL.md frontmatter.name.

catalog.name: skill_helper_creator
catalog.description: 仅在用户要求新建或改写 Skill 时使用；禁止作为导入失败的替代流程。创建或改进 Skill 前读取 Anthropic 官方 skill-creator 指导。由当前会话模型按需求编写内容，之后用 skill_helper_create 保存；不会启动 Claude CLI 或执行第三方脚本。

catalog.name: skill_helper_import
catalog.description: 导入本地 Skill 目录、GitHub 仓库/子目录、HTTPS 原始 Markdown/JSON 清单、本地 ZIP。返回 prepared 后再调用 skill_helper_install commit；selection_required 时让用户选目录。本地目录直接传原始路径，由宿主审批读取；无需 ls/read、网络或 creator。单个 Markdown 必须传 name；name 是安装目录名，只能用英文字母、数字、点、下划线、连字符，如 weekly-report；中文名称写在 SKILL.md 的 name 字段。失败后按 nextAction 处理，不要切换到 create 或 shell。

已按要求用 read 读取 `source.txt`（未修改文件）。文件共 3 行，基于读取到的内容逐行解释如下：

**第 1 行：`JEV_ALIGNMENT_20261002`**
这是一行不含等号、没有分隔符的标识符文本，由大写字母、下划线和数字组成。从字面看，它像是一个"名称 + 日期"形式的标头：`JEV_ALIGNMENT` 是主体名称，`20261002` 是一串八位数字，格式类似年月日（2026 年 10 月 02 日）。它可能是文件的标题、版本标识或记录编号，用于表明这份内容属于某个名为"JEV_ALIGNMENT"的条目。需要说明的是，这只是基于字符结构的合理推测；仅凭这一行无法确证它确切的语义。

**第 2 行：`alpha=17`**
这是一个典型的"键 = 值"格式条目，等号左边是键名 `alpha`（小写字母），右边是值 `17`（十进制整数）。结合文件整体看，它更像是一条参数配置记录，表示名为 alpha 的参数取值为 17。除此之外没有更多上下文能说明 17 的含义（如数量、系数、版本号等均无法从内容本身判断）。

**第 3 行：`beta=29`**
与第 2 行结构完全一致：键为 `beta`，值为整数 `29`。同样应理解为一条参数赋值记录，表示 beta 的取值为 29。

**整体说明**：三行合在一起看，第一行像是标题/标识，后两行是一组键值对参数，很可能构成一个简单的配置文件或记录片段。但必须强调：以上"配置参数""日期"等说法是基于文本格式的推断，读取内容本身只给出了这三行原文，未包含任何注释、说明或元数据来证实这些含义。若需要确证，需结合生成该文件的其他信息。
